 About The Job
 Capgemini is looking for an MS Azure DevOps Engineer to work in a dynamic environment, supporting infrastructure, applications, and DevOps processes across a modern Azure-based ecosystem. You will be involved in both operations and continuous improvement activities, contributing to system reliability, automation, and scalability.
 Your Responsibilities
Installation and configuration of Linux and Windows servers (OS customization, local firewall, networking and routing, etc.)
Scripting in Python, Lua, UDF, Bash, and PowerShell
Docker on Linux systems and knowledge of CI/CD
Knowledge of SQL language
Database administration, access and permission management
Knowledge of Active Directory (group membership management)
Management of applications such as Tableau Server, Theobald Xtract Universal, Nagios, Exasol, DataVault Builder, Power BI Report Server (e.g., installation, backup, monitoring, upgrades and updates, etc.)
Preparation of project documentation (e.g., HLD, LLD, SSRS, SecOps, etc.)
MS Azure Infrastructure
Entra ID (management of group memberships and app registrations/service principals)
DevOps
Linux
Knowledge of AMS processes
 Your profile
+5 years experience in a similar DevOps Engineer role
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a complex technical environment
Good communication and collaboration skills
